responsibilities: You’ll play a key role in leading and shaping our Business Intelligence tooling, ensuring robust governance, best practice and technical excellence across platforms including Power BI, QlikView and Business Objects.

You’ll work closely with Business Reporting, Data Engineering and business stakeholders, helping to deliver effective reporting solutions, drive self-service analytics and support data-driven decision-making.
You’ll contribute to the continuous improvement of our BI capability, focusing on technical standards, data quality, stakeholder engagement, innovation and the adoption of new technologies.
You’ll have opportunities to influence strategic data initiatives, lead technical delivery, share expertise and stay at the forefront of developments within the BI and analytics landscape.
You’ll be supported by an experienced and collaborative team, while also mentoring colleagues and helping to build a culture of learning, knowledge sharing and success.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: ensuring robust governance, best practice and technical excellence across platforms
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Governance, "accurate and reliable" information and "data quality" dominate; a single "fast-paced environment" mention does not shift it from rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: The Business Reporting team provides timely, accurate and reliable management information, analytics and insights that enable informed decision-making
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Insurance is a default-high sector, but the JD speaks only of "management information" for decisions with no regulatory or financial-reporting language, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: You’ll be supported by an experienced and collaborative team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An established reporting team running several BI platforms ("Power BI, QlikView and Business Objects") and focused on "continuous improvement" indicates a mid-maturity function.
evidence.jd_authorship: You’ll play a key role in leading and shaping our Business Intelligence tooling, ensuring robust governance, best practice and technical excellence across platforms including Power BI, QlikView and Business Objects.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Named platforms give some precision, but most bullets are generic ("share expertise", "stakeholder engagement"), so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: drive self-service analytics and support data-driven decision-making
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The primary audience is BI platform consumers served through tooling governance and "self-service analytics", not one business function.
evidence.autonomy_level: leading and shaping our Business Intelligence tooling
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic ownership of BI tooling ("leading and shaping") sits alongside execution for the business ("helping to deliver effective reporting solutions").
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The JD does not mention AI.
evidence.testing_framing: focusing on technical standards, data quality, stakeholder engagement
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and governance are framed as part of what the role improves and ensures, with no testing tools listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: timely, accurate and reliable management information
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Accuracy and reliability are a stated team purpose but secondary to delivering reporting and self-service, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: You’ll contribute to the continuous improvement of our BI capability
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The work improves and governs existing BI platforms rather than building new ones.
evidence.work_arrangement: Hybrid – a mix of home working and time in our Halifax office
evidence.loss_aversion: The Business Reporting team provides timely, accurate and reliable management information — reliability is the team's purpose but not framed as risk control.
